name: GST Invoice for India – Automatic Tax Invoice, CGST/SGST & B2B GSTIN for WooCommerce
author: krishnadas8119

sections.description:
Stop calculating Indian taxes manually. GST Invoice for India is a high-performance tax automation and documentation plugin designed specifically for Indian e-commerce businesses running WooCommerce.

Engineered by a Senior Systems Administrator with 16+ years of mission-critical infrastructure experience, this lightweight plugin guarantees flawless compliance with Indian Central and State GST rules without introducing slow database queries or checkout friction.

The calculation engine instantly identifies buyer locations at checkout to apply the correct structural tax split: CGST + SGST for intra-state orders, or IGST for inter-state shipments. It also adds a dedicated corporate input block to collect and display buyer GSTIN numbers for audit-ready business-to-business (B2B) transactional logs.

🇮🇳 Essential Features for Indian E-Commerce Stores:

  • Smart State-Based Tax Split Engine: Dynamically calculates localized tax percentages based on standard WooCommerce rules.
  • B2B GSTIN Checkout Field: Smoothly registers business credentials during checkouts to authorize complete corporate tax point credits.
  • Multi-Channel Download Gateways: Empowers customers to download printable PDF layouts via their My Account panel or directly on the checkout Thank You page.
  • Full HPOS Compatibility: Deeply optimized for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage architecture to accelerate page loads.

  • Automated Split Operations: Handles fast, background partitioning of CGST, SGST, and IGST components.
  • Native Invoicing Layouts: Generates professional, print-ready document structures featuring custom company details and custom serial prefixes.
  • HSN/SAC Code Support: Maps structural tax system classifications cleanly across standard digital inventories.
  • Zero Admin Panel Bloat: Follows absolute WordPress core programming architectures to keep processing completely light.
  • Clean Customer UX: Places intuitive billing download indicators inside default customer order management screens.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin directory to your server’s /wp-content/plugins/ directory path.
  2. Navigate into Plugins → Installed Plugins inside your WordPress dashboard and click Activate.
  3. Access the dedicated WooCommerce → GST Invoice India panel generated in your administration sidebar.
  4. Input your corporate registration keys, define custom document prefixes, and hit Save Settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support core WooCommerce setups?

Yes. A running configuration of WooCommerce is mandatory for the automated tax mapping and invoicing system to compute data loops correctly.

Does it handle both local intra-state and outside inter-state transactions?

Yes. The plugin reads customer billing parameters at checkout to separate intra-state calculations (CGST + SGST) from inter-state operations (IGST) flawlessly.

Is it fully compatible with custom database backends?

Yes. The system is designed to fully support WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) configurations without causing layout errors.
